description: This file defines an implementation of the PipelineElementVisitor interface, specifically an immutable version that uses functional interfaces (Function and Supplier) to handle visitor results. It includes a nested Builder class for constructing instances with custom behaviors.

classes.name: ImmutablePipelineElementVisitor
classes.description: A package-private, immutable implementation of the PipelineElementVisitor interface, parameterized with a result type T. It holds functional handlers for resolution, unresolved, and deleted states.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class used to construct instances of ImmutablePipelineElementVisitor with custom behavior for each visitor method.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Invokes the onResolution function with the provided resolved string.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Invokes the onIrresolution supplier to get the result for an unresolved state.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Invokes the onDeletion supplier to get the result for a deletion event.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutablePipelineElementVisitor instance after checking that all handlers are non-null.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Sets the Function handler for resolved events in the Builder.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Sets the Supplier handler for unresolved events in the Builder.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Sets the Supplier handler for deleted events in the Builder.
